title: Dell FY2026 Q4 results
summary: Dell FY26 closed more than $64B in AI-optimized server orders, shipped more than $25B, entered FY27 with a $43B backlog, and guided FY27 AI-optimized server revenue to roughly $50B, up 103% year over year.

title: Supermicro FY2026 Q2 results
summary: Supermicro remained an AI server assembly exposure, but margin, execution and governance risks require a lower risk-control score.

title: SemiAnalysis GB200 Hardware Architecture Component Supply Chain and BOM
summary: SemiAnalysis mapped GB200 rack-scale architecture and component implications, including that many data centers cannot support very high rack density without direct-to-chip liquid cooling.
